knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the facility buys an outcome it can check against its own schedule, with certainty. Your hourly rate, kit and business age are inputs or irrelevant to that purchase.
The lesson says a guarantee or fix-first promise must be one you can deliver and afford. An open-ended or impossible guarantee does not meet this.

The lesson says a measurable claim must be backed by evidence, and it warns against claims such as infection-free results without a source. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not support it.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
